skill_name: Reorganize a given paragraph to improve its flow and make it more effective.
workflow: We have seen that social distancing has been effective in reducing transmission of the virus and, in order to prevent the spread of COVID-19, it is important to adhere to these measures. Wearing a mask whenever in public is also necessary and washing your hands often helps to limit contact with the virus. Lastly, it is important to follow all of the social distancing and health protocols to reduce transmission.
